svg.title: Pocket Reader — PCB bottom view (GND plane)
svg.desc: Bottom view of the 45 x 24 mm board: continuous GND plane, antenna keep-out area, stitching vias, mounting holes and mirrored part courtyards.
svg.text: 45.0 x 24.0 mm · bottom layer a continuous ground plane · all 64 parts are on the TOP side · view from below

g.text: All 64 parts are on the top side. The bottom layer is a continuous GND plane, except the antenna keep-out area (docs/03 §2.4).
The drawn part outlines are only the COURTYARD contour — there is no copper or silkscreen on this side.
The view is FROM BELOW: X is mirrored. Text is not mirrored so it stays readable (it is mirrored in a production drawing).

svg.text: [x] Bottom layer is a continuous GND plane
[x] No copper in the antenna keep-out area
There are NO TRACKS on this side: the
plane pour is illustrative; the real
pour must be done in KiCad.
